notes: The ASV moves נָתַתִּי אִבְחַת־חָרֶב and its עַל phrase to the front of the verse; units follow the morphemes, not the order (rule 25).
The verse note Or, glittering concerns מְעֻטָּה and does not change the alignment.

The two *their*s are correctly distinguished: הַמִּכְשֹׁלִים carries an article and no suffix, so its article takes the possessive determiner written in its place (rule 41), while לֵב carries neither, so its *their* is added (rule 18). הַרְבֵּה is rendered by the predicate itself rather than a distinct intensifier, so rule 56 is properly not invoked.
